title: Bit Pulse Generator
statement: Implement a one-shot pulse generator that produces a single-cycle pulse whenever an input bit transitions from 0 to 1. The output must remain low otherwise and reset synchronously. This is useful for edge-triggered event capture in sequential logic.
module_signature: module bit_pulse_generator(input clk, input rst, input in_bit, output reg pulse);
behavior: pulse is 1 for exactly one cycle after a rising transition.
pulse is 0 for all other cycles.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not use asynchronous edge detection or latches.
hint: Store the previous sampled value and compare it to the current value.
